blocks.prompt: 12. A radioactive product has a half life of 5 years. If the radioactivity level is 68 microcuries after 20 years. Determine the original level of radioactivity.
blocks.explanation:
Half-life (aadhi umar) 5 saal ka matlab hai ke har 5 saal mein radioactivity aadhi reh jaati hai. To 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 saal par levels ek G.P. banate hain jis ka \(r = \frac{1}{2}\).
Yahan aakhri term (20 saal baad 68) diya hai aur pehla term (asal level) dhoondna hai.
Plan: 20 saal mein kitni half-lives, phir equation bana kar \(A_0\) nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: Half-life 5 saal; 20 saal baad level 68 microcuries.
Humein find karna hai: asal level \(A_0\).
Tareeqa: Har half-life par \(r = \frac{1}{2}\) wali G.P.: \(k\) half-lives baad level \(A_0(\frac{1}{2})^k\).

Half-lives ginein
\[\dfrac{20}{5} = 4\]
Kyun: Har 5 saal ek dafa aadha. 20 saal mein \(20 \div 5 = 4\) dafa aadha hua.

Equation bana kar hal karein
\[A_0\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)^4 = 68\]
\[\dfrac{A_0}{16} = 68\]
\[A_0 = 68 \times 16 = 1088\]
Kyun: 4 dafa aadha karna \(2^4 = 16\) se divide karne ke barabar hai. Ulta karne ke liye dono taraf 16 se multiply kiya.
Dhyan dein: 20 saal ko seedha 5 terms samajh kar \((\frac{1}{2})^5\) lagana ghalat hai; 0 se 20 saal tak 5 levels hain lekin halvings sirf 4.

Tasdeeq
\[1088 \to 544 \to 272 \to 136 \to 68 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 1088 ko chaar dafa aadha kiya (5, 10, 15, 20 saal par) to 68 aaya, jo diya gaya tha. Yeh tasdeeq is liye zaroori hai ke ulta hisaab (pichhe ki taraf jaana) mein aksar students 16 ki jagah 32 se multiply kar dete hain.
